item.title: 3 vehicles & household waste dumped which will become a fire hazard, 11th September
item.description:
Resident reporting on the carriageway there is a very large amount of dumped items, toilet ,big wooden box, rubble bags of all sorts, wood, hedging and grass brambles and bushes. There are also 3 vehicles without road tax & mot left there for months. One of the transit vans has a cage at the side with tons of paper and household waste, this is a fire hazard and if lit by kids it will go up in flames. Please could someone look into this, it has been reported several times under Ref (9965541)

item.title: On the road, between no. 11 and 12, 11th September
item.description:
For the past 2 months water has been oozing from the road very slowly. I work at Westminster City Council Public Protection and Licensing directorate (sdsantos@westminster.gov.uk), and I showed videos and pictures to my colleagues in Highways and they were extremely concerned with what might be happening underneath. They suggested this could potentially lead to a sinkhole so urgent attention is required. Samuel Dos Santos
